biography: With 3 years of experience across data engineering, automation, and software development, at multinational corporations, I've developed a versatile skillset with both breadth and depth.
I'm currently pursuing a Master of Science in Software Engineering Systems at Northeastern University, with the primary goal of securing a co-op opportunity as a software developer.

Previously, I worked as a Senior Data Analyst at EY, where I led the design, implementation, and testing of a customized ETL tool that went global across countries such as Poland, France, and Romania, serving clients like Boehringer Ingelheim and Roche.

I have hands-on experience in building desktop applications, web applications, and automation tools using technologies such as Python, React, Node.js, FastAPI, and Pandas. My key contributions include developing RPA solutions that reduced manual work by 85%, building machine learning models for stock market predictions, and creating dynamic data visualization applications with optimized query execution. I've also collaborated closely with cross-functional teams and mentored junior developers to enhance project efficiency and knowledge sharing. I'm passionate about full-stack development, cloud technologies, and data engineering, aiming to leverage my technical expertise to contribute to innovative projects. I currently live in Boston, enjoying exploring the city's vibrant tech community and outdoor activities in my free time.
